authorization.execution_class: one exploratory paired Level-1 seven-obstacle playback after safety gates

source_identity.exact_commit_and_tree: bound from the clean committed review vehicle by preflight before any Space construction; recorded in the one-use run receipt
source_identity.executable_source_paths_sha256: computed over the exact committed source set and recorded in the run receipt before stepping
source_identity.protocol_sha256: computed over the exact committed protocol and recorded in the run receipt before stepping

actuator.law: At each 0.1 s logical boundary set wheel-derived body linear velocity and yaw rate once. During each physics substep apply central force F=m*omega*J(v), using solver-evolved velocity, then let Pymunk integrate and solve contacts. No substep body-velocity reassignment; no contact-callback or contact-flag motor gating.
actuator.force_parameters: F=m*omega*(-vy,vx); uses existing body mass and held wheel-derived omega; no fitted gain or new numerical geometry/solver parameter
actuator.limitations: Idealized force-level actuator approximation; not a wheel hardware fidelity claim. Contacts can change speed and trajectory. Historical ContactWorld remains legacy #226 behavior; ContactWorldV4 and ObstacleContactWorld are the versioned successor.

paired_organism.seed_role: legal development seed; validated against all existing formal reservations before run
paired_organism.proposal_and_rng: unchanged aweform.d053.D053RoamingFixture initialized independently from seed 23002 in each arm; initial organism/environment RNG, controller state, observation, pose, station, battery, thermal and latch signatures must match before stepping
paired_organism.termination: Stop both arms at the first actual organism termination or shared 1800-command administrative horizon; preserve genuine sensory/action divergence. No action forcing or extra transition.

checks: finite state, no swept crossing, penetration upper bound <= 0.001 m
straight/reverse/spin/mixed-wheel free-space pose against exact differential-drive arc within 1e-5 m/rad
contact identities at west wall, A1, A2 and P1; contact sliding and reverse release
wall/P1 reverse release clearance gain >= 0.01 m
N400/N800 per-command position <= 0.0005 m, heading <= 0.001 rad, clearance <= 0.0005 m

hard_resource_guards.rss_enforcement: External parent polls child RSS using ps every 0.25 s and SIGKILLs its process group above 512 MiB; child also checks ru_maxrss at most every 100 Space.step calls. Darwin finite RLIMIT_RSS is unsupported.
hard_resource_guards.process_cpu_enforcement: Child RLIMIT_CPU hard limit plus process_time checks at most every 100 Space.step calls
hard_resource_guards.wall_enforcement: External parent kills child process group at 3600 s, including while native Space.step is blocked; child SIGALRM is a secondary guard
hard_resource_guards.retry_policy: Any started run consumes this bounded exploratory authority. Failures/cap stops are preserved; no automatic retry.

rendering.source: only saved actual safety/organism outputs; self-contained offline HTML, no network resources
rendering.synchronization: shared transition scrub/play/pause, actual actions remain per-arm after sensory divergence
required_views: N400 and N800 trajectories, body heading, dock and seven obstacles
